messages:
dan_sls: Heads-up: Orbitree wants a focused POC next week. Goal: validate catalog fit for 'orbitree-13b-comm' + a q4_0-lite quant variant for their orchestration layer. Needs: latency for streaming, KV/cache compatibility, security questionnaire answers (KMS + compliance), and a concise POC pricing note. Can we triage?

emma_se: I can take the fidelity and compatibility checks. Do they run mostly short commands or are they appending long conversational histories?

dan_sls: Mostly short control messages (~10-35 tokens), but they sometimes attach a 900+ token state blob. Traffic pattern: many concurrent tiny requests from edge devices.

rafa_infra: Important infra note: orbitree-13b-comm has two catalog KV options (compact-kv and hybrid-row). Hybrid-row stabilizes tail but uses more memory; will need to test both under streaming. I can spin a small harness.

li_sec: Security front: they asked about customer-managed KMS, data residency (US/EU), and whether we can provide model onboarding artifacts and a CVE scan summary. Hosted POC preferred; Dedicated if they require HSM.

viv_prod: For hosting, we support BYOK via KMS passthrough. I'll draft recommended text for the questionnaire. Also note: for healthcare-adjacent customers we usually recommend Dedicated for HSM and stricter auditability.

ops-bot: Starting ephemeral dev run for orbitree-13b-comm. Run ID: 553221.

rafa_infra: Suggested internal bench command to simulate their mix:

```bash
# internal micro-bench for mixed short + occasional long contexts
redwood-bench --model orbitree-13b-comm --variant q4_0-lite,float16 --kv-layout compact-kv,hybrid-row --seq-dist orbitree-seq-mix.json --concurrency 16 --streaming true --measure p95,p99,tokens_per_sec
```

rafa_infra: I'll run compact vs hybrid-row and post p95/p99 numbers. If we see >2x p95 on spikes, plan to propose prefix-KV caching and route-long-context to baseline float16 variant.

emma_se: Also ask Orbitree for a small eval set (40-50 prompts) so we can compare exact token-level diffs between float16 and q4_0-lite. For streaming control paths, deterministic sampling will give us cleaner diffs.

dan_sls: CSM said they'd upload prompts today. Demo is targeted Friday — can we provide bench, sec answers, and a one-pager pricing by Thursday EOD?

rafa_infra: Quick smoke pass done: concurrency 16, mostly short p95 float16 ~90ms, q4_0-lite ~120ms. With 900-token spikes p95 float16 ~510ms, q4_0-lite ~760ms. Hybrid-row reduced p99 by ~20% on mixed traces but reduced tokens/sec by ~9%.

viv_prod: Noted. I'll include a recommended mitigation matrix: 1) enable prefix-KV caching when contexts repeat, 2) route long transcripts to float16 baseline, 3) offer q4_0-lite only for latency paths after a fidelity check.

li_sec: Draft security reply: "Hosted POC: customer-managed KMS via passthrough, encryption at rest/in transit, onboarding artifact bundle (checksums + SBOM) provided. HSM-backed key storage available on Dedicated/Private deployments; full CVE/scan reports can be attached on request." Flag: if Orbitree insists on HSM for Hosted, we must move to Dedicated pricing.

emma_se: I'll run the fidelity diffs once prompts are uploaded. Expect small differences: q4_0-lite often changes numeric formatting and occasionally truncates tokens near stops. We'll quantify delta-rate and give examples.

dan_sls: Pricing sketch: propose a 2-week hosted POC block with a discounted token bucket and optional Dedicated uplift for HSM. Please keep pricing in the private thread.

ops-bot: Run 553221 completed: orbitree-13b-comm v1.4 deployed on ephemeral-dev. Artifacts uploaded.

rafa_infra: Logs and harness config uploaded. Action items recap: @emma_se run output diffs on 40-50 prompts (awaiting upload); @rafa_infra attach full bench logs + mitigation checklist (done); @li_sec finalize sec answers & attach onboarding artifacts; @viv_prod prepare one-page POC pricing card. Target: Thu EOD.

emma_se: Once prompts arrive I'll post a short summary: delta %, example mismatches, and suggested pinning per intent.

dan_sls: Orbitree CSM said prompts will be in by EOD. I'll update them that the demo is tentative until we confirm fidelity. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
